subject: npmx Weekly #24
headline: npmx Weekly #24
intro: Exciting updates and community engagement are on the rise in the npmx ecosystem. Dive into this week's top highlights that are driving innovation and collaboration among developers.

topics.title: Nub Package Manager Integration
topics.summary: The integration of the nub package manager into npmx enhances flexibility by allowing users to choose it alongside npm and yarn, improving command execution speed and supporting workspace functionality.

topics.title: Module Federation Optimization
topics.summary: A partnership with @sanity.io has optimized the Module Federation Vite plugin, drastically reducing its dependency size and showcasing effective collaboration in enhancing software efficiency.

topics.title: Vite Download Surge
topics.summary: Vite has seen a remarkable 4x increase in downloads over the past six months, indicating a significant shift in the npm ecosystem and the rising preference for faster, more efficient build tools.
